articles.description: Audible is introducing an AI-assisted synopsis feature that's designed to help users determine whether they'll enjoy an audiobook before they jump in and start listening to it. articles.description: Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop.
